note: The Lean names are drift for omega^RG, paths for A^path, width for w^path, columns for C_j, relaxation for R^rel and supportExponent for sigma, with `L` the ratio ell_m.

snippet.text:
kick (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ G.slopeConstant/4
  slow (hj : p.first ≤ j) : (p.profile j).drift / Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹
  fits (hj : p.first ≤ j) :
    let X := p.profile j
    Real.log (1 + X.paths + X.width⁻¹ + X.columns + X.clip.relaxation + X.supportExponent) /
      Real.log L.val ≤ ((j:ℝ)^2)⁻¹

proof_context.conclusion: For a side `L` at stage `j`, `drift / log L ≤ slope/4` and `≤ j^(-2)`, and `log(1+paths+width⁻¹+columns+relaxation+supportExponent)/log L ≤ j^(-2)`.
